test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six colleagues are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Amrita is sitting second to the left of Kavita. Meagan is sitting second to the right of Sabina. Rohan is an immediate neighbour of both Kavita and Amrita. Rochelle is an immediate neighbour of both Meagan and Sabina. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Meagan?
solution:
Given: Six colleagues are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) Amrita is sitting second to the left of Kavita. 

2) Rohan is an immediate neighbour of both Kavita and Amrita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca7e69f315acbab5911939072dce9391255fc26ae0c4f062c2d4f835a7f2d8ed.png] 

3) Meagan is sitting second to the right of Sabina. 

4) Rochelle is an immediate neighbour of both Meagan and Sabina. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9e116e1e3c769a1502dafde783fef197d08d7acb76f168f90b92eeb654587ad.png] 

So, 'Amrita' is sitting to the immediate right of Meagan.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
